description: Contact section dark theme upgrade and Footer redesign. Transform contact form to dark premium theme with glass-effect form fields. Redesign footer as multi-column dark footer with brand, quick links, programs, contact info sections.
steps: INSPECT contact component thoroughly: Read contact.ts, contact.html, contact.css. Document ALL functionality: ContactForm interface (name, email, phone, subject, message), form object with ngModel bindings, status signal ('idle'|'loading'|'success'|'error'), errorMsg signal, info[] array (4 items: address, phone, email, hours - CURRENTLY UNUSED IN HTML), onSubmit() method calling api.service.post('contact', form), ApiService dependency, FormsModule import, isLoading/isSuccess/isError helper methods. CRITICAL: DO NOT modify contact.ts logic - only CSS styling changes allowed.

VERIFY contact template dependencies: In contact.html, verify: uses FormsModule directives [(ngModel)], (ngSubmit), #contactForm="ngForm", conditional rendering @if (isError()), @if (isSuccess()), uses form-group/form-label/form-input/form-textarea/form-submit-btn classes, map-placeholder with map-marker SVG, 4 info-cards (address, phone, email, hours) with static content. ALL TypeScript bindings and event handlers MUST be preserved.

CSS-ONLY changes to contact.css - PHASE 1 (Section background and title): In #contact selector, change background to dark: 'background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0A0A0A 0%, #040001 100%)' or 'background: #0A0A0A'. In .contact-title, change color to '#FFFFFF'. Keep .contact-title-blue as-is (likely already #2563EB). Save, run 'npx ng build --configuration development', check terminal for CSS errors.

CSS-ONLY changes to contact.css - PHASE 2 (Form labels and inputs): In .form-label, change 'color' to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)', set 'font-size: 0.7rem', 'letter-spacing: 1.5px', 'text-transform: uppercase', 'font-weight: 700'. In .form-input and .form-textarea, change 'background' to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)', 'border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)', 'color: #FFFFFF', 'border-radius: 8px', 'padding: 12px 16px'. Add placeholder styling: '.form-input::placeholder, .form-textarea::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); }'. Save, build, check.

CSS-ONLY changes to contact.css - PHASE 3 (Form focus states): Add focus styles: '.form-input:focus, .form-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2563EB; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1); }'. Ensure form-submit-btn has good contrast on dark background (check existing styling, likely already blue gradient). Save, build, check.

CSS-ONLY changes to contact.css - PHASE 4 (Feedback messages): Update .form-feedback.error: 'background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)', 'border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)', 'color: #ef4444'. Update .form-feedback.success: 'background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)', 'border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3)', 'color: #22c55e'. Save, build, check.

CSS-ONLY changes to contact.css - PHASE 5 (Map and info cards): In .map-card, change 'background' to 'rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.8)'. In .map-placeholder, change 'background' to '#1a1a1a'. In .map-location-name and .map-location-address, change colors to white/light gray. In .info-card, change 'background' to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', 'border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'. In .info-card-label, change color to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'. In .info-card-value, change color to '#FFFFFF'. Save, build, check.

VERIFY contact styling: Start dev server, navigate to contact section. Check: dark background, form labels uppercase and light gray, input fields have glass effect with dark background, placeholder text visible, focus states work (blue border glow), submit button prominent. Type in form fields to test input visibility. Check map section and info cards for readability on dark background.

INSPECT footer component: Read footer.ts, footer.html, footer.css. Document: footer.ts has explore[] array (5 links), programs[] array (5 links), socials[] array (3-4 items with label, href, svg), year property (current year). Footer.html has footer-grid with 4 columns: footer-brand (logo + description), footer-col for Explore links (using @for loop), footer-col for Programs links, footer-col for Contact (with footer-dotted-frame icons and contact info). Footer-bottom has copyright and social icons. PRESERVE: all arrays, all links, all @for loops, all TypeScript logic.

CSS-ONLY changes to footer.css - PHASE 1 (Background and borders): In footer selector, change 'background' to '#040001' or '#0A0A0A'. Add 'border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'. Save, build, check terminal.

CSS-ONLY changes to footer.css - PHASE 2 (Brand and columns): In .footer-brand p (description), change color to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)'. In .footer-col h4, change color to '#FFFFFF', set 'font-weight: 700'. In .footer-col a (links), change color to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)', on hover change to '#2563EB'. In .footer-contact-label, change color to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'. In .footer-contact-value, change color to '#FFFFFF'. Save, build, check.

CSS-ONLY changes to footer.css - PHASE 3 (Footer bottom): In .footer-bottom, add 'border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)', 'padding: 1.5rem 0'. In .footer-bottom span (copyright), change color to 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)'. Verify .social-link SVG icons are visible (should already have fill/stroke set to white/light color). Save, build, check.

VERIFY footer styling: In browser, scroll to footer. Check: dark background, premium top border visible, logo and description readable, all column headings white and bold, all links gray and hover to blue, contact info readable, copyright text gray, social icons visible and clickable. Click several footer links to verify navigation preserved.

FINAL BUILD AND FUNCTIONAL TESTING: Run 'npx ng build --configuration development'. Should show no errors. Start dev server. FORM TEST: Fill out contact form with test data (name: 'Test User', email: 'test@example.com', phone: '1234567890', message: 'Test message'). Click Submit. Verify: loading state shows ('SENDING...'), API call executes (check Network tab in DevTools), success or error message appears. NAVIGATION TEST: Click multiple footer links, verify routing works. Open browser console, check for JavaScript errors. If any functionality broken, document in findings and fix before marking complete.
